title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-28
source: Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on crome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones; Transferred on Mason's restored Nak550

ai_review.summary: A listenable audience recording of the infamous Red Rocks rain‑out night – audio is fair with rain noise, but the performance holds historic charm.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the July 28 1982 Red Rocks show where the band played through a steady rainstorm. Reviewers note that the sound is not as clear as other Mason sources—rain patter is audible—but it remains listenable and the night is fondly remembered despite the weather.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give a moderate (3‑4 star) impression; the show is regarded as decent/pleasant while the recording quality is only fair, yielding an overall rating around 3.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is less clear than other Mason copies; rain on the tape can be heard, making it a bit muddy but still listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set flow; reviewers simply note the night’s historic vibe despite the rain.
